about: Shared test cases for session ceilings (ADR-0006). Each ceiling is a CLI session's `authorization_details`; each case is an operation on a target and whether the ceiling admits it. The typed API's check (rise-backend-auth) and the resource API's engine (rise-authz) must both agree with every case, so a session means the same thing before and after a kind migrates. `environment` is the Environment's name for an Environment operation and the resource's `rise.dev/environment` label for an environment-bound kind. `refusedBy` lists the evaluators that must reject a ceiling outright (an invalid credential); the others still check its cases. Regenerate the `details` of request-backed ceilings with RISE_BLESS_SESSION_CEILINGS=1 cargo test -p rise-backend-auth.

empty.about: An empty list is an invalid credential, never full access.

mixed.about: `view`,`logs` project-wide plus `deploy` on staging. The engine can't read the `labelSelector` an environment grant carries until ADR-0006 §8 step 2.

project-admin.about: `admin` on the whole project: every permission.

staging-deploy.about: `deploy` on one environment. The engine can't read the `labelSelector` an environment grant carries until ADR-0006 §8 step 2.

staging-develop.about: `develop` on one environment: deploy plus environment-specific env vars. The engine can't read the `labelSelector` an environment grant carries until ADR-0006 §8 step 2.

staging-secrets.about: `view` and `secrets` on one environment. The engine can't read the `labelSelector` an environment grant carries until ADR-0006 §8 step 2.

unknown-type.about: An entry of another type is an invalid credential.

wildcard.about: A `*` entry on the project. The engine's matchers accept wildcards; the typed check knows only the named kinds and verbs and refuses the claim. Rise never mints one.
